Diamond of Purity

Epic · Active · Cooldown: 5→4 turns

Skill by star

0★
Base skill
Restores HP by 7% of the owner's Max HP for an ally and other 2 allies with the lowest HP. Meanwhile, cleanses 1 layer of DoT debuff from them.

Full skill text at 5★
Restores HP by 10% of the owner's Max HP for an ally and other 2 allies with the lowest HP. Meanwhile, cleanses 1 layer of DoT debuff from them. If the DoT debuff is successfully cleansed, additionally restores the target's HP by 3.5% of the owner's Max HP. If the target has 100% HP, the HP healing effect will be converted into granting the target a [Shield] by 15% of the owner's Max HP instead, lasting for 2 turns.
Full skill text at 7★
Restores HP by 10% of the owner's Max HP for an ally and other 2 allies with the lowest HP. Meanwhile, cleanses 1 layer of DoT debuff from them. If the DoT debuff is successfully cleansed, additionally restores the target's HP by 4% of the owner's Max HP. If the target has 100% HP, the HP healing effect will be converted into granting the target a [Shield] by 20% of the owner's Max HP instead, lasting for 2 turns. Cooldown -1 Grants [Block Debuff] on the main target for 2 turns.
Source: game files.

Effects

  • [Shield] — Blocks some DMG.
  • [Block Debuff] — Cannot be inflicted with debuffs.
